reviews.author: N N
reviews.text:
We booked a private tour to Cairo and the Giza Pyramids with Stella Sharm, and honestly, we couldn’t have asked for a better experience!

As a group of four women, we were initially a little hesitant about booking a private tour, especially given the long journey from Sharm el Sheikh. However, Mohammed, the owner of Stella Sharm, couldn’t have been friendlier or more communicative from the very beginning. He was always happy to answer our questions and made sure we felt comfortable and reassured throughout the booking process.

The tour itself was fantastic! We had a comfortable minivan all to ourselves, which made the long drive so much more enjoyable. We were also incredibly lucky to have Fares as our guide. He was extremely knowledgeable, patient with all our questions and genuinely passionate about sharing Egypt’s history. He made sure we managed to fit in everything we wanted to see while keeping the day well balanced between sightseeing and shopping, so we never felt rushed or that we were missing out on anything.

We opted to visit the Grand Egyptian Museum, and we are so glad we did! It was absolutely worth seeing, and we were genuinely in awe of the Tutankhamun collection on display. Fares did a brilliant job explaining the history behind the exhibits and sharing fascinating stories along the way. I particularly enjoyed how he brought the history to life rather than simply taking us from one attraction to another.

All in all, we had a wonderful day and would not hesitate to recommend Stella Sharm to anyone considering a trip to Cairo. A big thank you to Mohammed for making the arrangements so smooth and, of course, to Fares for being such a fantastic guide. If we ever return to Egypt, we would definitely be happy to book with them again!

reviews.author: denice Ribera
reviews.text:
Con Stella Sharm Tours, ¡todo fue simplemente maravilloso!

Desde el primer momento, la experiencia fue excelente. El proceso de reserva fue fácil, rápido y sencillo. En ningún momento sentimos presión, falta de atención ni desinterés. Todo nos fue explicado de manera detallada, clara y transparente, lo que nos dio mucha confianza desde el principio.

Las excursiones que elegimos fueron las siguientes:

1. Excursión a El Cairo en autobús

El autobús era muy cómodo, nuestro guía tenía una gran cultura y amplios conocimientos, y la comida local que nos ofrecieron estaba deliciosa.

¡Sin duda, fue una de las mejores excursiones que hemos hecho en nuestra vida!

2. Excursión Jeep Safari, Cañón y Blue Hole

También disfrutamos de una excursión increíble en Jeep Safari, durante la cual visitamos el cañón y después fuimos al Blue Hole, donde practicamos snorkel. Para terminar, disfrutamos de un precioso paseo en camello junto al mar.

Fue una experiencia muy especial y divertida. Todo lo que nos habían explicado antes de reservar se cumplió tal y como esperábamos.

Contratamos el paquete VIP completo, y sinceramente es una opción que recomendamos a todo el mundo. ¡Merece muchísimo la pena!

3. Excursión privada en Quad Bike por el desierto

Después hicimos una excursión privada en quad por el desierto, rodeados de unos paisajes montañosos realmente impresionantes. ¡Fue una experiencia emocionante, divertida y absolutamente espectacular!

Nuestro guía fue fantástico, siempre atento, amable y dispuesto a ayudarnos.

También disfrutamos de un paseo en camello por el desierto, contemplamos las estrellas a través de un telescopio y asistimos a diferentes espectáculos tradicionales, con música, canciones y bailes locales.

Los espectáculos fueron tan divertidos que incluso nos invitaron a subir al escenario y participar con ellos en algunos bailes. ¡Fue un momento inolvidable!

La cena BBQ también fue excelente: deliciosa, variada, bien preparada y, sobre todo, limpia y apetecible.

4. Actividades acuáticas

Para completar nuestras vacaciones, también reservamos varias actividades acuáticas:

- Parasailing.
- Banana Boat.
- Sofa Boat.

¡Todas fueron experiencias emocionantes y muy divertidas! Las recomendamos sin ninguna duda.

Lo que más valoramos de Stella Sharm Tours

Además de las excursiones, queremos destacar la profesionalidad de todo el equipo.

Los conductores fueron siempre educados y respetuosos, y los guías estuvieron pendientes de nosotros y de cada pequeño detalle durante las excursiones.

La comunicación con la empresa fue siempre fácil, directa y rápida. Algo que valoramos especialmente fue la flexibilidad que demostraron en todo momento para cambiar horarios y modificar nuestro programa de excursiones. Siempre nos ayudaron con una actitud positiva, sin presiones, molestias ni una sola muestra de descontento.

Es una empresa que realmente se preocupa por sus clientes y por ofrecerles unas vacaciones especiales.

¡Gracias de todo corazón, Stella Sharm Tours! ❤️

Sois una empresa verdaderamente profesional, seria y de confianza. Nos hemos sentido atendidos, acompañados y cuidados durante toda nuestra estancia en Sharm El Sheikh.

¡Por supuesto que volveremos a contar con vosotros!

En enero regresaremos para descubrir Petra con Stella Sharm Tours.

¡Hasta pronto y muchísimas gracias por todo!

reviews.text:
More Than Just Excursions – Wonderful Memories with Stella Sharm Tours!

We spent our family holiday in Sharm El Sheikh and decided to explore more of Saini rather than spend all our time at the hotel. Choosing Stella Sharm Tours turned out to be a great decision!

We booked four different experiences: a private bus trip to Ras Mohammed, scuba diving, the Colored Canyon and a Jeep Safari in the desert. Each excursion had something special to offer, and together they made our holiday much more enjoyable.

What we appreciated most was how straightforward everything was. From our first enquiry to the actual excursions, the staff were friendly, helpful and easy to communicate with. Our questions were answered quickly, the details were explained clearly, and the prices were reasonable. Everything was as agreed, which gave us peace of mind when planning activities for the family.

Ras Mohammed was a lovely opportunity to discover the natural beauty of the area, while scuba diving gave us a closer look at the incredible underwater world of the Red Sea. The Colored Canyon was another highlight, with its unusual rock formations and beautiful colours. The Jeep Safari brought a completely different atmosphere, allowing us to enjoy the desert scenery and experience the adventurous side of Sinai.

A special thank you to Mr. Hassan and Sherif for their knowledge, guidance and friendly approach. They helped make our experiences enjoyable and memorable. It's always a pleasure to meet people who are good at what they do and make you feel comfortable along the way.

We also want to thank the entire Stella Sharm Tours team for their organisation, patience and professionalism. What made the difference for us was not just the excursions themselves, but the feeling that we could rely on the people arranging them. There was no unnecessary pressure, no unpleasant surprises and no confusion about what we had booked.

Travelling as a family, you really appreciate these things. You want to enjoy your time together, discover new places and come home with good memories rather than spend your holiday worrying about arrangements.

Stella Sharm Tours helped us do exactly that.

If you're visiting Sharm El Sheikh and want to experience more than just the hotel and the beach, we would recommend considering their excursions. We had a very positive experience, enjoyed discovering different parts of Sinai and were happy with the service we received.

Thank you to the whole team for being part of our family holiday. We will remember these experiences for a long time, and we would be happy to meet you again on a future trip to Egypt! 🇪🇬

We travelled with our family and booked several private trips with Stella Sharm Tours, including Petra, Luxor, St. Catherine’s Monastery and Mount Sinai. Everything was perfectly organised, and we couldn’t be happier with our experience.

From the very beginning, communication was easy and quick, the prices were reasonable, and everything was exactly as explained to us before booking. All our trips were private and tailored to our preferences, which made the whole experience even more special.

A big thank you to Mr. Ahmed and Mr. Mohamed for their excellent communication and the smooth booking process. Even when we changed our plans on the day of a tour, they handled everything quickly and without any stress. We really appreciated their flexibility and willingness to help.

What we liked most was that everything was as promised. No surprises, no pressure, just honest service and well-organised trips.

We would also like to thank Mr. Tarek for his knowledge and the interesting way he explained the history and culture of the places we visited. We learned a lot and truly enjoyed our time with him.

Finally, a special thank you to our driver, Reda, for his kindness and friendly attitude, especially towards our children. He made us feel comfortable and safe throughout our journeys.

Thank you, Stella Sharm Tours, for helping our family create such wonderful memories in Egypt!

We highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, flexible and personalised excursions in Sharm El Sheikh. We would definitely choose them again on our next visit..

Disappointing Experience – Good Sales Service, Poor Delivery

We booked an excursions through this tour operator during our holiday in Sharm El  a day trip to Cairo to visit the pyramids.

Unfortunately, the experiences fell short of expectations.

The Cairo excursion itself was interesting, with good content and plenty to see. However, the arrangements were frustrating. At booking, we were advised of a 4am collection, only to be informed the day before of significant flight and timing changes. We were told we would return at 11pm, but it was actually 12:30am. This was not the experience or schedule we had agreed to.

The vehicle used in Cairo was also disappointing. It was unclean, had an unpleasant smell, and the standard of driving was concerning.

On arrival at the airport, the representative met us and assisted with our visas, but we were then asked for additional money by a porter at check-in, which we refused. This added to the disappointment.

What makes this particularly frustrating is that the communication and service before booking were very good. We felt confident booking through this operator, but sadly the delivery did not match the promises.

I raised all these concerns directly with the tour operator, giving him the opportunity to respond and address our disappointment. Unfortunately, I have received no response, which genuinely surprised me given how attentive and helpful he was before taking our booking.

We spent a considerable amount of money on these excursions and expected a better standard of service and customer care.

There were enjoyable moments, but overall, a disappointing experience. Good customer service should not end once payment has been made.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Experiência incrível em Sharm El-Sheikh com a Stella Sharm Tours!

Fiz dois passeios com a equipe da Stella Sharm Tours e a experiência foi perfeita do início ao fim. Profissionalismo, pontualidade e atenção aos detalhes em tudo!

📍 Tour 1: Mosteiro de Santa Catarina & Dahab
* Horário: Saída às 05:00 da manhã e retorno por volta das 16:00.
* O que incluiu: Transporte em veículo confortável com ar-condicionado, guia profissional e muito atencioso, todas as taxas e ingressos, além do almoço na cidade de Dahab.
* Como foi: A visita ao mosteiro (das 09:00 às 11:15) foi muito enriquecedora graças às explicações do guia. Em seguida, fomos para Dahab, e preciso destacar que o almoço estava ótimo!

📍 Tour 2: Super Safari 3x1
* Horário: Das 17:00 às 22:00.
* O que incluiu: Passeio de quadriciclo (Quad Bike), chá beduíno, passeio de camelo, jantar completo e show noturno.
* Como foi: A experiência no deserto foi super divertida! A comida do jantar estava maravilhosa e o show cultural no final foi um espetáculo à parte, com dança étnica, performances com fogo e até atrações com cobras.
Recomendo de olhos fechados para quem busca passeios organizados, com ótima gastronomia e total segurança!

Unforgettable Two-Day Cairo Experience! 🇪🇬✨

Had an absolutely fantastic experience from start to finish with Stella Sharm Tours.

We spent two unforgettable days exploring Cairo, and every moment was beautifully organised.

On the first day, we visited the magnificent Pyramids of Giza and the Grand Egyptian Museum, where we were amazed by the incredible history and treasures of ancient Egypt. We also enjoyed a relaxing Nile cruise and a delicious lunch at a lovely local restaurant.

Our hotel room had a direct view of the Pyramids, which made the experience even more special. Waking up with such an incredible view was truly unforgettable. 🏛️❤️

The second day was just as amazing. We visited the historic Citadel of Muhammad Ali and the beautiful Al-Nasir Muhammad Mosque, before continuing to Khan El Khalili and exploring the heart of Islamic Cairo.

Our car was air-conditioned, comfortable and spotless, and our driver was extremely polite, professional and punctual throughout the entire trip.

Our guide was exceptional. He was incredibly knowledgeable and explained the history in such a fascinating way that, for a moment, it felt as though we had travelled back thousands of years and were witnessing ancient Egypt with our own eyes.

Everything was organised perfectly, from the transportation to the sightseeing and meals. We felt comfortable, safe and well looked after throughout the entire journey.

Thank you, Stella Sharm Tours! ❤️🇪🇬

You truly were the best ambassadors for your country. You made our visit to Cairo not just a trip, but a beautiful and unforgettable experience.

And next time, we are definitely going with you by plane to Luxor — that’s for sure! ✈️🏺

Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Петр Шилин
reviews.text: Хотим выразить огромную благодарность агентству Stella Sharm Tours за организацию нашего индивидуального двухдневного тура в Александрию из Шарм-эль-Шейха. Это было абсолютно незабываемое путешествие!Отдельно хочется отметить финансовую сторону: цена тура в Stella Sharm Tours оказалась честной и адекватной, она кардинально отличается в меньшую сторону от цен, которые заламывают отельные гиды за аналогичные поездки. При этом качество и сервис здесь — на самом высшем уровне!С самого первого контакта менеджеры проявили безупречный профессионализм: логистика была просчитана поминутно, перелеты авиакомпанией EgyptAir подобраны идеально, а предложенный отель XU San Stefano с видом на Средиземное море — это просто восторг.Огромное спасибо нашему водителю — вежливому, аккуратному и пунктуальному. Дорога между городами пролетела незаметно, так как мы ехали на отличном, современном автомобиле с кондиционером, что в условиях египетской жары просто бесценно. Профессиональное и безопасное вождение — отдельный огромный плюс!И, конечно же, наша самая теплая благодарность гиду Мухамеду! Мухамед — не просто гид, а невероятно эрудированный, интеллигентный человек, искренне влюбленный в историю Египта. Подача материала настолько живая, что два дня экскурсий пролетели как одно мгновение. Катакомбы Ком-эш-Шукафа, цитадель Кайт-Бей, Александрийская библиотека — благодаря Мухамеду мы прочувствовали всю душу этого города. Он окружал нас заботой, подсказывал лучшие ракурсы для фото и выбирал отличные места для обедов.Если вы ищете безупречный VIP-сервис, комфорт, честные цены и команду профессионалов — искренне рекомендуем Stella Sharm Tours, гида Мухамеда и их замечательного водителя. Спасибо за сказку в Александрии!

reviews.author: Hema Farouk
reviews.text:
Une expérience vraiment exceptionnelle avec Stella Sharm Tours !
On a réservé un circuit privé au Caire conçu spécialement selon nos envies, et franchement on n’aurait pas pu demander mieux. Le transfert était inclus de l’hôtel jusqu’à l’aéroport, et notre guide Adel, qui parle parfaitement français, était juste génial. Il connaît son sujet par cœur, il raconte de façon vivante et captivante, on ne s’ennuyait jamais une seconde.
On a visité les pyramides et le Sphinx, le nouveau Grand Musée Égyptien qui est vraiment impressionnant, le Musée des Civilisations, la citadelle de Mohamed Ali, Khan el-Khalili et la mosquée Amr ibn al-As, la plus ancienne d’Afrique. Tout était bien organisé et le repas était délicieux, vraiment savoureux.
Ce qui m’a le plus marqué, c’est la fluidité de tout : dès le premier contact jusqu’au retour à Sharm, tout s’est passé sans le moindre souci. Une organisation au top qu’on ne s’attendait pas forcément à trouver ici.
Le lendemain on est partis avec eux au Canyon Coloré et au Blue Hole, et on a terminé le séjour par une belle sortie en yacht dans la baie de Tiran. Des moments magiques.
Le rapport qualité-prix est excellent, le service est au top et ils restent disponibles avant, pendant et après chaque sortie. Moi, ma femme et nos enfants on remercie toute l’équipe de Stella Sharm Tours, et particulièrement les guides et les chauffeurs qui étaient super gentils. Les enfants les ont adoré !
On recommande les yeux fermés.

Amazing Sunrise Quad Biking Experience With camel ride !!

Had an absolutely fantastic experience from start to finish.

We were picked up from our hotel at around 4:00 a.m. and taken to the safari centre, where we were each given our own quad bike. Our guide, Waleed, was exceptional. He took the time to explain everything clearly, made sure we were comfortable and confident on the bikes, and guided us safely through the desert.

The desert scenery was breathtaking. One of our stops was at the Temple of Echoes, which was great fun as a group. We all enjoyed hearing our voices echo back through the mountains. We also stopped to watch the sunrise, and the timing was absolutely perfect. Seeing the sun come up over the desert was a truly memorable experience.

We continued our ride to another location where we enjoyed a camel ride, and the camel handlers were wonderful. They took their time with us and captured some lovely photos, making sure everyone had a great experience. We were then welcomed with traditional tea, met some local people, and had the opportunity to take photos.

After riding back to the safari centre, our driver was waiting to take us back to our hotel.

Overall, this was an unforgettable excursion and excellent value for money. Waleed was a 10/10 guide, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Whether you choose a private guide or go as part of a group, I’m sure you’ll have a fantastic time. Highly recommended! 🌅🏜️🐪🏍️

reviews.author: Ahmed Amer
reviews.text:
Ho avuto il piacere di affida stella sharm per le escursioni durante la mia vacanza e devo dire che è stata un’esperienza straordinaria sotto ogni punto di vista. Fin dal primo contatto ho percepito grande serietà, professionalità e una cura autentica verso i clienti, qualità che purtroppo non sono scontate.

Abbiamo partecipato a due escursioni: la motorata nel deserto e l’uscita a Ras Mohammed in bus. Entrambe organizzate alla perfezione, con guide attente, disponibili e preparate, capaci di trasmettere passione e amore per la loro terra. L’organizzazione logistica è stata impeccabile, dai tempi rispettati alla qualità delle attività proposte, fino alla gentilezza di tutto lo staff che ha reso ogni momento piacevole e sicuro.

Purtroppo, durante l’escursione prevista all’Isola che non c’è, mio amico ha avuto un problema di salute che ci ha costretto a rinunciare. In quell’occasione abbiamo potuto toccare con mano la grande umanità e professionalità di stella sharm: il personale ha reagito con prontezza, ci ha assistiti con estrema disponibilità e ci ha accompagnati in albergo garantendo la sicurezza di mio marito. Non si sono limitati al “minimo indispensabile”, ma hanno fatto molto di più di quello che ci si potrebbe aspettare, continuando anche nei giorni successivi ad informarci sulle sue condizioni di salute con sincero interesse.

Un ringraziamento particolare va al responsabile , che con la sua attenzione e gentilezza ci ha fatto sentire davvero tutelati e considerati. Nonostante l’imprevisto, non ho perso neanche un centesimo per l’escursione a cui non abbiamo potuto partecipare, un gesto di correttezza e disponibilità che merita di essere sottolineato.

In un mondo dove troppo spesso si guarda solo al guadagno stella sharm dimostra che la differenza la fanno le persone: uno staff straordinario, professionale, serio, ma soprattutto umano. Grazie a tutti voi per aver reso la nostra vacanza speciale e sicura anche nei momenti di difficoltà. Non posso che consigliarvi con il cuore a chiunque voglia vivere l’Egitto con serenità e affidandosi a mani esperte.

Complimenti davvero a tutta l’organizzazione: siete un esempio di professionalità e umanità!
